name: NayaNET Canonical Hub Preservation and Freeze Gate
purpose: Prevent accidental loss, silent authority transfer, architectural forgetting, and unverified production drift in the canonical human-facing Hub.

preservation_rules.rule: Existing Hub -> preserve -> add room/surface -> verify. Never reconstruct the Hub around a room.
preservation_rules.authority_transfer_rule: Moving the active Hub implementation between artifacts or architectures requires an explicit recorded transfer with source, destination, reason, preservation checkpoint, and verification scope.
preservation_rules.destructive_change_rule: A destructive or replacement change is blocked unless the preservation checkpoint and explicit authorization are recorded.
preservation_rules.historical_evidence_rule: Historical Hub implementations remain recoverable evidence and must never be treated as disposable working files.

current_checkpoint.advancement_reason: Approve deployment of verified live-repair fixes on the canonical static Hub: G1 canonical Smart Notes 404 (PR #544) and G2 $ is not defined x3 (PR #545). Both proven deterministic with interception probe: 10 console errors to 0. Pure surgical repairs inside the frozen canonical entrypoint; no authority transfer, no architecture change, no visual surface change.

recorded_authority_transfer.verification_requirement: Static source/build/deploy/live/browser parity must pass before restoration is considered production-proven.
